# Chinmaye Hotels

> A family of hotels, resorts and kitchens across Bihar & Jharkhand, India, built on one promise: "Mehmaan bhagwan hote hain" (guests are gods). Founded in Bhagalpur, the Silk City on the Ganga.

## Properties
1. Hotel Chinmaye Inn — Bhagalpur, Bihar. OPEN NOW. Est. 2015, 60 rooms & suites, Kesaria rooftop restaurant, five banquet halls (Maya, Manjusha, Maithili, Mandala, Moonlight). https://inn.chinmaye.in/
2. The Chinmaye Grand — Banquet & Resort at Sarvesh Royal Garden, Bhagalpur, Bihar. OPENING SOON. Garden weddings, conventions, resort stays. https://grand.chinmaye.in/
3. Chinmaye Deoghar — near Baba Baidyanath Dham, Deoghar, Jharkhand. OPENING 2027. https://chinmaye.in/deoghar/
